steps.en: Install the app and choose capture inbox settings
steps.zh: 安装应用并决定截图收件箱设置

steps.en: Capture using the existing macOS shortcut
steps.zh: 用原有 macOS 快捷键截图

steps.en: Notice the capture and hold it on the hidden strip
steps.zh: 发现截图并放到可收起的图片条

steps.en: Reveal the strip and copy or drag the image into the report
steps.zh: 唤出图片条，把图片复制或拖入报告

value.en: Temporary screenshots stay reachable without piling up on the Desktop
value.zh: 临时截图随手可取，不再堆满桌面
